diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

`helm_release.karpenter` explicitly depends_on `module.karpenter`, but its `values` already reference `module.karpenter.service_account` and `module.karpenter.queue_name`, so the ordering is already implied by an attribute reference.

`null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class` explicitly depends_on `module.eks`, but its `triggers`/local manifest already reference `module.eks.cluster_primary_security_group_id` and `module.eks.cluster_security_group_id`, so the dependency is already implicit.

`null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class` explicitly depends_on `module.karpenter`, but its `triggers` and local manifest already reference `module.karpenter.node_iam_role_arn`, so the dependency is already implicit.
`null_resource.update_kubeconfig` explicitly depends_on `module.eks`, but its local-exec command already references `module.eks.cluster_name`, so the dependency is already implicit.

`null_resource.delete_daemonset` deletes the `aws-node` VPC CNI DaemonSet, which should only happen after Calico has been installed via `null_resource.create_calico_installation`. Currently it only depends on `update_kubeconfig`/`module.eks`, so Terraform may remove the VPC CNI before Calico is in place, leaving the cluster without pod networking.
